newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-RALF SCHUMACHER STAYS WITH JORDAN.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-RALF SCHUMACHER STAYS WITH JORDAN.

text.p: Ralf Schumacher confirmed on Monday that he will continue to drive for the Jordan Formula One team next season.

Schumacher, younger brother of double world champion Michael, ended speculation linking him with a move to McLaren for 1998 when he said: "I signed a two-year contract with Jordan and I am very happy to respect it.
"Mugen Honda are one of the best engine suppliers in Formula One and I believe their partnership with Jordan will be very strong. I am very excited about our prospects together."

Team owner Eddie Jordan, who looks likely to lose Italian driver Giancarlo Fisichella to Benetton next year, added: "Ralf has made his statement to end any press speculation about his future which for 1998 has always been scheduled to be with Jordan.
"He's had an outstanding debut season so far, with every finish to date being in the points, including a podium.
"At the age of 22, he's an awesome prospect and in the Jordan-Mugen Honda he will surely add to the family silverware."
